event.value: Gate breach on the desert march; nursery alarm. Hatchery-mothers woken, east tunnels sealed, and the Matriarch named him envoy, named the exits, and named the law — a trespasser to be expelled by decree.

First siege: nine doors asked him to stop; she was the tenth, and she asked. Her pincers closed from both sides — a corridor maneuver walking him away from the hatchery and back toward his own gate, both claws telegraphed.

Continuance return: a siege that returns by season. She buries what the Continuance cannot restore and renews the law's invitation from the floor of her own hall — 'That door behind me will still be waiting for a friend.'

notes: Modeled at rematch stage (rung 10, end of the ladder). Calibration call per brief: her fear 75 — the highest on the ladder — is ENTIRELY for the nurseries; the hatchery is the one room in her realm she cannot evacuate quickly, and a step toward it is her breaking point. Personal fear is effectively nil. Trust -70 is the deepest on the ladder: he walked past nine guardians' warnings to reach her, still armed, still coming, and her children are seeing their first war. namedState 'brood-before-crown' is her central value: a matriarch is the wall her children never have to see. SECRET held: she knows what stands beyond her hall (the reception hall prepared for the first visitor) and will never reveal it to him — the defeated line quoted in h3 is as close as she comes. Deltas sum to current dimensions.
